package.name: san_sim_gazebo
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Gazebo Garden simulation integration.
Ported and adapted from skyhunter_gazebo (Limon code). Provides: - 3 simulation worlds (empty, obstacle, tactical_test) - ros_gz_bridge configuration for sim ↔ ROS 2 topics - Single-robot + swarm spawn launch files - Multi-robot world generation utility
Enables PDR evaluation visual demonstration of swarm behaviors (Hungarian formations, KPP-2 evasion, BT priority subtrees) in a controlled Gazebo environment without HW.
